summary: The diff implements the core score editing and recalculation functionality as specified in the BuildRequest. All three requirements appear to be addressed: REQ-1 through maintaining editable input fields in GolferScoreEntryList, REQ-2 through automatic recalculation managed by React state updates, and REQ-3 through the useMemo hook in LeaderboardView that recalculates results when golfers data changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an 'Edit Scores' button in the LeaderboardView with Edit icon from lucide-react
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly lists in non-goals: 'Creating a separate edit mode or edit button'. However, the diff adds an Edit Scores button with Edit icon in LeaderboardView.tsx.
